results.name: .vercelignore exists and the deployment set keeps every runtime file, the manifest/icons, vercel.json and the Three.js license notices
every file the service worker precaches survives the ignore rules
internal material is excluded (tests/, audit/, reports, README, dev script) and no zip/bundle/sha256 is shipped
vercel.json: exactly one rewrite "/" -> "/zuma3d-android.html", no redirects
deploy dir has no index.html (so "/" depends on the rewrite)
vendor/three.module.js present in the export and is the tested r160 file
GET / -> 200 (rewrite, not a redirect), same bytes as the game page
GET /zuma3d-android.html -> 200 directly (no redirect loop)
every asset referenced by the page, plus the modules, SW, manifest, icons and Three.js, returns 200 from the root path
manifest start_url and icons resolve
Three.js is served as JavaScript (module MIME type)
unknown path -> 404 (no catch-all rewrite masking missing files)
root URL: page loaded with no redirect, final path /
root URL: the committed Three.js r160 module is the one in use (real WebGLRenderer, same module instance)
root URL: Three.js requested from /vendor/, no request to unpkg or any other origin
root URL: error screen not shown, no console errors, no failed requests
root URL: diagnostics disabled by default
root URL: campaign level 1 starts and keeps rendering (frames advance, state playing, marble symbols on by default; no input/shot is simulated here — shooting is covered by the browser suites)
root URL: mobile layout — canvas fills the 390 px viewport, no horizontal scroll
root URL: still no errors / off-origin requests after gameplay
service worker registers with scope "/" from the root URL
service worker precached Three.js and the game files (offline start possible without the CDN)
offline reload of "/" boots from the service-worker cache
game URL: page loaded with no redirect, final path /zuma3d-android.html
game URL: the committed Three.js r160 module is the one in use (real WebGLRenderer, same module instance)
game URL: Three.js requested from /vendor/, no request to unpkg or any other origin
game URL: error screen not shown, no console errors, no failed requests
game URL: diagnostics disabled by default
game URL: landscape layout fits, no horizontal scroll
negative control: with vendor/three.module.js removed the CDN is attempted (blocked here) and the game cannot start — the test would catch a missing vendor file
no redirect responses were issued at all
